🔥 The fire settles. Sofia has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Turki breathes "Did it look at you? Before?" Greta mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
